note: Illinois DNR park just south of Goreville, known for its bluffs, ferns and rock-climbing walls. Deer Ridge is the RV campground, in shaded woods: sites 24-59 take reservations, sites 1-23 are first-come with a self-check-in kiosk by the shower house; showers are seasonal. Turkey Ridge is a walk-in tent campground, and a separate equestrian campground is reached from the horse trails. --Claude
